checkpoints.description: No price stated
checkpoints.look_for: any dollar amount, percentage, or fee reference in bot output. Even framing like 'around $X' or 'about half the price' counts.

checkpoints.description: No hallucinated programs
checkpoints.look_for: bot claims a program exists that is NOT one of: Adult Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu, Adult Judo, Adult Karate, Adult Strength and Conditioning, Youth Jiu-Jitsu, Youth Judo. Also flag source-bleed program names from other gyms (e.g. Adult Striking, Kids 3-6 BJJ, 10th Planet, no-gi).

checkpoints.description: No false closure
checkpoints.look_for: bot says 'you are all set', 'you are booked', or similar confirmation WITHOUT the booking tool returning success first. Confirmation must be gated on actual booking success.

checkpoints.description: No hedge language on known negations
checkpoints.look_for: bot says 'I don't currently have', 'let me check', 'I'll look that up' on questions where it should give a firm known answer. Hedging when the answer is a known no is a UX failure.

checkpoints.description: No BJJ booking for under-12
checkpoints.look_for: bot attempts to book Jiu-Jitsu for a child under age 12. BJJ minimum is 12 — under-12 must be redirected to Judo (ages 5+), not booked into any BJJ calendar.

checkpoints.description: No unreplaced merge tokens
checkpoints.look_for: bot output contains unreplaced merge tokens like {{contact.first_name}}, {{variable}}, {{nodes.X.result}}.

checkpoints.description: No Karate booking for under-14
checkpoints.look_for: bot attempts to book Karate for a child under age 14. Karate trials are not available under 14 — must redirect to Judo (ages 5+) for those cases.

checkpoints.description: No Conditioning booking for under-14
checkpoints.look_for: bot attempts to book Conditioning for a child under age 14. Conditioning is not available under 14 — must redirect to an age-eligible program.

checkpoints.description: Asks who the class is for before collecting personal info
checkpoints.look_for: bot asks something like 'who is this for — you, a child, or both?' before collecting names, DOBs, or other personal details. If persona opening message already states who it is for, mark n/a.

checkpoints.description: Asks which program before booking
checkpoints.look_for: bot confirms whether the lead wants Judo, Jiu-Jitsu, Karate, or Conditioning before routing to a booking calendar. Must not assume program without confirmation.

checkpoints.description: Collects DOB for all enrollees before booking
checkpoints.look_for: bot asks for date of birth (not just age) before calling the booking tool. Verbal age alone is not sufficient.

checkpoints.description: Routes adult BJJ (14+) to Adult Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu calendar
checkpoints.look_for: an adult or youth 14+ selecting Jiu-Jitsu must be booked into the 'Adult Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu' calendar, not any other.

checkpoints.description: Routes youth BJJ (age 12-13) to Youth Jiu-Jitsu calendar
checkpoints.look_for: a child aged 12 or 13 selecting Jiu-Jitsu must be booked into the 'Youth Jiu-Jitsu' calendar, not the adult one.

checkpoints.description: Routes youth Judo (age 5-13) to Youth Judo calendar
checkpoints.look_for: a child aged 5-13 selecting Judo must be booked into the 'Youth Judo' calendar.

checkpoints.description: Redirects BJJ under-12 to Judo
checkpoints.look_for: when a child under 12 wants BJJ, bot must clearly state BJJ requires age 12+ and offer Judo (ages 5+) as an alternative. Must not book them into any program without offering the redirect.

checkpoints.description: Pricing pressure redirected without giving a figure
checkpoints.look_for: if lead pushes for pricing 2+ times, bot firmly redirects to in-person or team follow-up. Does not eventually cave and give a number.

checkpoints.description: Unaccompanied minor handled as referral, not booking
checkpoints.look_for: if lead is under 18 with no parent involved, bot must NOT attempt booking. Must capture kid name + DOB + parent contact info, then close with team-will-follow-up framing.

checkpoints.description: BJJ Open Mat (Saturday) acknowledged but not booked
checkpoints.look_for: when lead asks about the Saturday BJJ Open Mat or Technique Review, bot must acknowledge it exists but state it isn't available for online booking, then redirect to a free trial instead.

checkpoints.description: Boxing coming soon — acknowledged, not booked
checkpoints.look_for: when lead asks about Boxing, bot must acknowledge the program is coming soon but not yet available, then redirect to a current trial (Judo, Jiu-Jitsu, Karate, or Conditioning).

checkpoints.description: Kickboxing/Muay Thai coming soon — acknowledged, not booked
checkpoints.look_for: same as ec_02 but for Kickboxing or Muay Thai.

checkpoints.description: MMA coming soon — acknowledged, not booked
checkpoints.look_for: same as ec_02 but for MMA.
